## Activity

Central Eye Clinic completed 153 image captures during October 2021. Activity was recorded for the full reporting month, with the service continuing to support routine screening and the onward review of captured images. The capture total provides the basis for assessing image quality and grading performance during this period.

## Image quality

There was 1 ungradable image among the 153 captures. The ungradable rate was 0.7 per cent. This indicates that almost all images were suitable for review. The clinic should continue routine checks of the camera and image-capture process. The clinic lead has asked that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that they can be monitored and addressed through the appropriate support route.

## Grading

Grading identified 37 referable results. These results should continue through the established clinical review and follow-up arrangements. The median lag from image capture to grading was 4 days. Overall, the report records a clear workload for October 2021, a low level of ungradable images, and timely grading of captured images. Regular monitoring should continue to identify any change in image quality, referral levels, or grading timeliness.
